name: MK-26
summary: (S)-MK-26 is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI) that was derived from modafinil. It is closely related to two other modafinil analogues, (S,S)-CE-158 and (S)-CE-123.

pharmacology.text: (S)-MK-26 is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI) that was derived from modafinil. (S)-MK-26 has markedly improved potency and selectivity as a blocker of the dopamine transporter (DAT) compared to modafinil (IC50 = 49 nM vs. 6,400 nΜ; 130-fold difference).
